_comment: Config for the articles -> broker-simulator parallel-run (Stage 5). The service token is read from env BROKERSIM_SERVICE_TOKEN and is NEVER committed here. The mode->account map is OPTIONAL: an empty value means the tools resolve the account at runtime from GET /api/accounts by matching the label 'mirror:<mode>'. Pin a UUID here only to bypass that lookup.
_cutover_doc: cutoverDays = consecutive zero-divergence reconciliation days a mode must achieve before cutover-decision.js promotes it to 'sim' in data/source-of-truth.json. Once 'sim', gen-api.js + gen-status-page.js render that mode's positions + equity from the broker-simulator (via data/sim-source-cache.json, refreshed nightly) instead of pit-state — with a HARD FALLBACK to pit-state on any error / missing token / missing cache. A single fresh divergence on a 'sim' mode auto-reverts it to 'articles'. Override the threshold per-run with env CUTOVER_DAYS. pit-state is still computed in shadow regardless.
